**Why monotonic time is useful for measuring elapsed time:**

`time.monotonic()` is designed specifically for measuring durations because it is immune to system clock adjustments. Unlike `time.time()` (wall-clock time), which can jump forward or backward when NTP syncs, daylight-saving changes, or manual edits occur, monotonic time only ever moves forward.
